ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The attached figure shows a JFET cross-sectional schematic: the left side is labeled Source, and the right side is labeled Drain; there is a Gate region on both the top and bottom, and both the upper and lower gates are connected to the same gate voltage VG; the upper and lower gate regions are marked p+, and the middle is a conducting channel region. From the figure it can be known that the channel is jointly controlled by the depletion layers of the upper and lower gate junctions. Reasoning: Suppose that when VG = -2 V, the depletion layer depth extending from each gate into the channel is xd. For the initial device, normalized by the initial pinch-off voltage VP, there is 2xd/W = sqrt(2/VP). Therefore the initial effective conducting aperture is W - 2xd = W[1 - sqrt(2/VP)]. When the width W is doubled to 2W, while other geometric parameters and doping concentration are unchanged and the bias VG is also unchanged, the actual depletion layer depth xd remains unchanged. Thus the modified effective conducting aperture is 2W - 2xd = 2W[1 - sqrt(1/(2VP))]. Under the condition that the remaining parameters are the same, transconductance gm is proportional to the effective conducting aperture, so the ratio of the transconductance of the initial and modified JFET is W[1 - sqrt(2/VP)] / {2W[1 - sqrt(1/(2VP))]} = (1/2)*((1 - sqrt(2/VP))/(1 - sqrt(1/(2VP)))).

method.method_draft: Let the depletion depth from each gate at VG = -2 V be xd. For the initial device, normalize xd using the initial pinch-off voltage VP: 2xd/W = sqrt(2/VP), so the conducting aperture is W[1 - sqrt(2/VP)]. If W is doubled while doping and bias are unchanged, xd itself is unchanged, so the new aperture is 2W - 2xd = 2W[1 - sqrt(1/(2VP))]. Since gm is proportional to this effective aperture under the same remaining device parameters, compute gm_initial/gm_modified = W[1 - sqrt(2/VP)] / {2W[1 - sqrt(1/(2VP))]} = 1/2*((1 - sqrt(2/VP))/(1 - sqrt(1/(2VP)))).
method.CoT_raw:
图像描述：附图显示的是一个JFET横截面示意图：左侧标为Source，右侧标为Drain；上下各有一个Gate区域，并且上下栅极都接到同一个栅压VG；上下栅区中标有p+，中间为导电沟道区域。由图可知沟道受上下两个栅结的耗尽层共同控制。

推理：设在VG = -2 V时，从每个栅极向沟道内扩展的耗尽层深度为xd。对初始器件，用初始夹断电压VP归一化，有 2xd/W = sqrt(2/VP)。因此初始有效导电孔径为 W - 2xd = W[1 - sqrt(2/VP)]。当宽度W加倍为2W，而其他几何参数和掺杂浓度不变、偏置VG也不变时，耗尽层实际深度xd不变。于是修改后的有效导电孔径为 2W - 2xd = 2W[1 - sqrt(1/(2VP))]。在其余参数相同的情况下，互导gm与有效导电孔径成正比，所以初始与修改后JFET的互导之比为 W[1 - sqrt(2/VP)] / {2W[1 - sqrt(1/(2VP))]} = (1/2)*((1 - sqrt(2/VP))/(1 - sqrt(1/(2VP)))).

method.method_draft: Start with gm(W, VP) = C W[1 - sqrt(|VG|/VP)]. For the original device, |VG| = 2, so gm_initial = C W[1 - sqrt(2/VP)]. When W is doubled, the pinch-off voltage becomes VP_modified = 4VP because VP scales as W^2. Thus gm_modified = C(2W)[1 - sqrt(2/(4VP))] = 2CW[1 - sqrt(1/(2VP))]. Taking the ratio cancels C and W, giving gm_initial/gm_modified = 1/2*((1 - sqrt(2/VP))/(1 - sqrt(1/(2VP)))).
method.CoT_raw: 图像描述：附图显示一个JFET的截面结构，左侧标有Source，右侧标有Drain，上下两侧为Gate并分别接到V_G；上下栅区标为p+，中间区域是源漏之间的沟道。因此题目讨论的是该JFET几何宽度W变化对跨导的影响。推理：按指定方法，JFET互导写为 gm(W, V_P) = C W [1 - sqrt(|V_G|/V_P)]。原器件中 V_G = -2 V，所以 |V_G| = 2，因此 gm_initial = C W [1 - sqrt(2/V_P)]。当宽度 W 加倍且其他几何参数和掺杂不变时，按方法草案 pinch-off 电压按 W^2 缩放，所以 V_P_modified = 4 V_P。修改后器件的宽度为2W，因此 gm_modified = C(2W)[1 - sqrt(2/(4V_P))] = 2CW[1 - sqrt(1/(2V_P))]。取初始器件与修改后器件的互导之比，C和W抵消，得到 gm_initial/gm_modified = (1/2) * (1 - sqrt(2/V_P))/(1 - sqrt(1/(2V_P))).
